units.source: Some note types (such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and saved search) intentionally limit the width of the content.

This might appear surprising at first, but the idea is to make text fit well on wider screens without appearing distorted. This is especially the case if the document contains __TRILIUM_PH_0__Images__TRILIUM_PH_1__, tables or other width-dependent elements.
Configuring the content width and alignment__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Content width > Configuring the content width and alignment

units.source: The content width is expressed in pixels and can be changed from __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Appearance__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Content Width__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and adjusting the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Max content width__TRILIUM_PH_7__ section.
units.context: Content width > Configuring the content width and alignment

units.source: To effectively disable the content width limitation, simply set the width to a value larger than your screen size (e.g. 9999).
units.context: Content width > Configuring the content width and alignment

units.source: By default, the content is aligned to the left, but it can be centered horizontally by checking __TRILIUM_PH_0__Keep content centered__TRILIUM_PH_1__ from the same section as the content width.
units.context: Content width > Configuring the content width and alignment
Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: For notes with large elements such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_1__, it sometimes makes sense to avoid the content width without affecting other notes. To do so:
units.context: Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: Go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and toggle __TRILIUM_PH_2__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: Or manually apply the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__label__TRILIUM_PH_2__ to the note.
units.context: Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: Since v0.107.0, a single table can also be made wider than the content width, in which case it scrolls sideways. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: Some __TRILIUM_PH_0__note types__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are full width by default, such as the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_3__. In that case the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Full width__TRILIUM_PH_5__ toggle will not be displayed and the label will have no effect.
units.context: Content width > Adjusting at note level

units.source: On a __TRILIUM_PH_0__shared page__TRILIUM_PH_1__, a text note is shown at a fixed reading width, whatever the width configured in Options, and the navigation tree, the content and the table of contents are kept together in a column centered on a wide screen. A note with __TRILIUM_PH_2__, or of a type that is full width in the application, uses the whole width of the window there, with the navigation tree and the table of contents at its edges.
